## Summary
[What maintenance task, refactor, or cleanup is needed? Keep it specific.]

## Motivation / Why
[Why do this now? Is it blocking other work? Reducing tech debt? Improving developer experience? Speeding up builds/tests? Be honest about the urgency.]

## Scope / Location
[Which files, modules, or services will this touch?]

## Proposed Approach (Optional)
[If you have an idea of how to tackle it (e.g., "Replace deprecated library X with Y", "Extract service layer", "Update CI pipeline"), write it down. If it’s a purely routine task (e.g., "Bump Node version"), just say so.]

## Risks / Trade‑offs
[What could go wrong? Does this introduce breaking changes? Will it affect performance? Should we do it in phases?]

## Things to note
[Any dependencies, required migrations, or external communication (e.g., notify the frontend team). Also mention how we’ll verify that the change is successful.]
